verdict.rationale: Lorikeet provides AI-generated insights and suggestions across the product: ticket diagnosis with root-cause tracing, knowledge base gap/quality auditing, simulation-based workflow impact analysis, and Coach's automated quality scoring of 100% of conversations, all surfaced natively in-app and via MCP/Claude/ChatGPT. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of insight accuracy beyond vendor docs, and more detail on how suggestions are surfaced proactively to end users versus on-demand queries.
